en: When I am at the throne of the Lord, how shall I come to You, O Lord
I will come to the throne of the Lord by the cross of Christ for me
You lead me to the throne of grace though I am not worthy at all
So I will come to the throne of grace by the love of Christ for me
Let me see you face to face, take me to the place where You are
Not by all the power I have, But by the blood of Jesus Christ
By the blood of the lamb, through the love of Christ
Let us come boldly to Your throne
By the blood of the lamb, through the love of Christ
Let us come and worship You, Lord
